rows.text: The deformed chimera gnaws off a piece of stone wall, romping about in the room. Because of the erroneous fusion of two chimerae, the inorganic monster sprouts spines, growling menacingly at you all.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Having achieved fame, you suddenly realize that this is the result of a stroke of luck from the erroneous data that you ignored all those years ago. If this matter were to get out, you would surely be unceremoniously cast out of the Grove.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Looking at the monster before you, you decide to...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You raise an iron rod and fight the crazed chimera for three bouts, finally ending up with a pile of scrap metal. You now understand what the scrap metal pieces your mentor had you deal with really are...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Grappling with every ounce of your strength, you manage to lock up the crazed chimera. It will be shown as the results of animal reintroduction into the wild at the Caprism school's exhibition.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Your scandal has become a hot topic within the Grove, but at least future scholars won't be obstructed by such blunders again.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
